column3: NKJV begins with “And the Lord said,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it. NKJV renders the plural “you all” as “you.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “to Me” after “returned.”
NKJV has “before you will deny,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “until you deny.”
NKJV supplies “sword” to “he who has no,” making explicit what the Greek leaves implied.
NKJV includes “still,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.

NKJV has “Have you come out,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text uses the aorist “you came out.”
